summary: Frontend-only test of File Browser UI iteration: (a) 'Getting Started' card is removed from /storages, (b) view toggle list/grid + localStorage persistence, per-folder search, colored file-type icons, (c) FilePreview modal for image/pdf/text/code/docx (mammoth)/xlsx+csv (SheetJS), (d) breadcrumb collapse dropdown at depth>3 with header actions kept on one row, (e) download from list/grid/preview and folder create + navigation. Also created live SFTP storage PREVIEW_sftp (id 6a63f0aee7a3962d514a0957) via API against the local sftp server 127.0.0.1:2222 with sample files provided by main agent. All specified UI features work as expected. One race-condition bug found on initial storage switching that can display stale files from the first auto-selected storage.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: on first landing on /files, the initial loadFiles() for the auto-selected storage (r.data[0], e.g. STAGING S3) is still in-flight when the user clicks another storage (e.g. PREVIEW_sftp). If the slower response arrives AFTER the faster one, setItems() from the stale request overwrites the current storage's files. Result: header shows PREVIEW_sftp but the list still shows STAGING S3 folders (backups / nexus-backups / uploads). Reproducible by clicking PREVIEW_sftp within ~1s of landing on /files. Fix: guard loadFiles() with a request id / AbortController and ignore responses where active.id no longer matches; or clear items when active changes.

/files: storage switcher lists all 3 storages; SFTP root shows notes.txt, data.csv, config.json, laporan.docx, rekap.xlsx, dokumen.pdf, banner.png (+ upload folder).
view-list-button / view-grid-button toggle between file-row-<name> table and file-card-<name> grid; preference persisted to localStorage 'files_view' and restored across reload.

Deep-nesting (deep_a/deep_b/deep_c/deep_d): breadcrumb-collapse '…' button appears at depth 4 and its DropdownMenu contains the hidden parents (deep_a, deep_b). Clicking a hidden folder navigates to it.
Header layout at deep breadcrumbs: breadcrumbs and Folder / Upload / UserMenu buttons remain on a SINGLE row (measured bcTop=23 vs upTop=17 within ~8px; headerHeight ~71px). No wrap.
new-folder-button + folder-name-input + create-folder-button work; upload-file-button visible for write storages.
action_items: Fix race condition in /app/frontend/src/pages/Files.jsx loadFiles(): ignore responses whose storage no longer matches active (use ref/AbortController), OR clear items and show loader immediately when active changes (setItems([]) + setLoading(true) before await).
(Optional) Clear items when path changes / when active changes to avoid brief flash of previous folder content.
critical_code_review_comments: Files.jsx loadFiles is not cancellation-safe. If two switches fire in quick succession, the slower response wins and the UI becomes inconsistent with the highlighted storage.
Preview modal uses onClick on the backdrop to close AND onClick on file rows to open — both work, but stopPropagation on the modal is correct. No issues observed.
FilePreview: dynamic import of 'mammoth/mammoth.browser' + 'xlsx' works; first render is ~1-2s as expected. Consider prefetching on hover of previewable rows to reduce perceived latency.
Files.jsx is ~470 lines; still manageable but could be split (header/breadcrumbs, toolbar, list view, grid view, folder-dialog) for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: PREVIEW_sftp storage already exists (id 6a63f0aee7a3962d514a0957). Sample files include banner.png/dokumen.pdf/notes.txt/config.json/laporan.docx/rekap.xlsx/data.csv in the SFTP home. When testing storage switch, wait ~6s after landing on /files before clicking switch-storage-<id> to avoid the stale-response race that overwrites the file list. Or fix the race in Files.jsx first.
rca of the issue: Race condition in /files: On mount, api.get('/storages') resolves and setActive(r.data[0]) is called for the first storage (STAGING S3). useEffect([active, loadFiles]) fires loadFiles(''), which does GET /api/storages/{stagingId}/files. STAGING S3 has ~4s response time due to bucket listing. Meanwhile the user clicks switch-storage-<sftpId> so active becomes PREVIEW_sftp and loadFiles('') is issued for SFTP. SFTP responds fast (~600ms) so items are set to the sftp file list. Then STAGING S3 response arrives (~4s later) and setItems overrides items with staging's files. UI now shows PREVIEW_sftp highlighted but staging files (backups/nexus-backups/uploads) listed. Repro: log in, navigate to /files, immediately click PREVIEW_sftp in the sidebar. Mitigation: use a request-id ref inside loadFiles and drop responses whose active.id != current; alternatively use AbortController and cancel the in-flight request when active changes.
